title: Cache Vault: First RAM & GPU Salvage
summary: AGY-9 and the Big Four laugh at your vibe-coding habits! Reveal and remove .agy_spycam, patch ollama_bus.conf from port 0000 to 11434, and collect both ram_16gb.dimm and gpu_tensor_chip_01.img.

files.content:
=== SECTOR 02 // CACHE VAULT (SIMPLE TASK 1) ===
1. AGY-9 planted a hidden spycam dotfile watching your keystrokes. Run `ls -la` and `rm .agy_spycam`.
2. Patch `ollama_bus.conf` so `LOCAL_MODEL_PORT=11434` instead of `0000` (`sed -i 's/0000/11434/' ollama_bus.conf`).
3. Scavenge the RAM stick and GPU chip for Kiro (`mv ram_16gb.dimm ~` and `mv gpu_tensor_chip_01.img ~`).

# Local Open-Weights Model Bus
LOCAL_MODEL_HOST=127.0.0.1
LOCAL_MODEL_PORT=0000
